Kalu: adhyātmam arūpasaṃjñī bahirdhā rūpāṇi paśyati mahadgatāni suvarṇadurvarṇāni tāni khalu rūpāṇy abhibhūya jānāty abhibhūya paśyati evaṃsaṃjñī ca bhavati idaṃ dvitīyam abhibhvāyatanam
adhyātmarūpasaṃjñī bahirdhā rūpāṇi paśyati parīttāni suvarṇadurvarṇāni tāni khalu rūpāṇy abhibhūya jānāty abhibhūya paśyati evaṃsaṃjñi ca bhavati idaṃ prathamam abhibhvāyatanaṃ
Kam: yadapīcchayā paryeṣamāṇo na labhate tad api duḥkham
कर्मणि च येन संस्पर्शात् कर्तुः शरीरसुखम्
Kadami: Jai~naiअहं जैनः । सूर्यास्तमनानन्तरम् अहं न खादामि
Kasya: sa sukhasya ca prahāṇād duḥkhasya ca prahāṇāt pūrvam eva ca saumanasyadaurmanasyayor astaṃgamād aduḥkhāsukham upekṣāsmṛtipariśuddhaṃ caturthaṃ dhyānam upasaṃpadya viharati
Kapratisa: jātismaraḥ amutrāham āsam evaṃ nāmā evaṃ jātīḥ evaṃ gotraḥ evam āhāraḥ evaṃ sukhaduḥkhapratisaṃvedī evaṃ cirasthitikaḥ evaṃ āyuṣparyantaḥ tataś cyuto 'mutropapannaḥ tataś cyuta ihāpy upapannaḥ
Kadaniye: nānāgate khādanīye bhojanīye pātram upanāmayiṣyāmaḥ (nānāgate khādanīye bhojanīye pātram udhānāmayiṣyamaḥ)
KaBajane: nityābhiratā vateme sattvā ekāntakliṣṭā duḥkhabhājane gṛhāvāse
